text:
alex.cs: Hey team, customer reported 403s on /v1/generate while embeddings and rerank calls succeed. Customer says it started after SSO provisioning this morning.

leah.support: Thanks Alex. Can you paste a minimal curl + response (sanitized) and the key id? Also which tenant?

alex.cs: Tenant: tenant-acme, key_id: key_01F7X. Repro curl:```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_01F7X' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"redwood/gpt-large","input":"hello"}'
```Response (403):```json
{"error":{"code":"insufficient_entitlements","message":"missing scope: generate","status":403}}```Customer also sent decoded JWT claim (obfuscated):```json
{"sub":"svc-acme","scopes":"embeddings;rerank","iat":1700000000}```So scopes are a single string with a semicolon delimiter. :confused:

mike.eng: Semicolon in scopes. Uhoh. Our provisioner historically wrote comma-separated scopes. If the SSO CSV import used semicolons (customer locale) the claim ended up with the literal string 'embeddings;rerank' instead of two separate scopes. Our auth code compares exact scope tokens so it doesn't match 'embeddings' or 'generate'. That explains embeddings endpoint working only if we have special-case parsing? Strange that embeddings worked though. Did they call embeddings with a different key?

alex.cs: Customer confirms same key used for both endpoints. embeddings API returned 200 with vectors. I'll attach stack trace they captured in their app logs where we return 200 for embeddings but 403 for generate.

mike.eng: Quick theory: embeddings endpoint code attempts a substring match for 'embed' (legacy) so it matched despite the semicolon, but generate endpoint uses exact-match against known scope set -> failed. We should normalize scope parsing at issuance time and in auth middleware.

eng_oncall: Agreed. Short-term remediation = rotate the key or run admin re-provision to normalize scopes. Long-term = change provisioner to split on /[\",;\s]+/ and make auth middleware accept semicolon/space delimited lists.

jess.support: To unblock the customer ASAP, suggest we: 1) create a temporary key for them with explicit scopes (embeddings, rerank, generate), 2) advise rotation, 3) file a ticket for provisioner hotfix. Can ops create temp key and mark for 1-hour expiry? :+1:

leah.support: Filing an immediate escal ticket to eng + security for key creation. Alex, can you confirm the customer is OK with rotate now? They'll need a maintenance window ~10m.

alex.cs: Customer says yes, do it now.

mike.eng: For the record, repro steps I used locally:```bash
# reproduce bad token (simulated claim)
echo -n '{"sub":"svc-acme","scopes":"embeddings;rerank","iat":1700000000}' | base64 | sed 's/=*$//'
# then curl generate with that token -> 403
```Patch idea (small):```diff
- // split scopes by comma only
- const scopes = rawScopes.split(',').map(s => s.trim());
+ // accept comma, semicolon, or whitespace separators from provisioning feed
+ const scopes = rawScopes.split(/[,;\s]+/).map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
```Will open PR for auth middleware + provisioner normalization.

deploy-bot: roll/12345: hotfix-provisioner-scope-parsing scheduled to deploy to staging in 5m. :rocket:

eng_oncall: I'll approve a one-off admin create-key for tenant-acme (key_temp_01) with scopes: embeddings,rerank,generate and set TTL=1h. Then coordinate with support to rotate.

customer_qa_bot: Created ticket CS-8721, assigned to mike.eng and jess.support.

leah.support: Thanks, eng_oncall. Alex pls confirm with customer once temp key is active.

alex.cs: Confirmed with customer after temp key creation: generate works. They're rotating to new key and will confirm after 1h. Customer appreciated quick fix. :thumbsup:

mike.eng: I'll ship the small parsing fix to staging and add unit tests for comma/semicolon/space. Opening PR now and will include migration script to re-normalize existing tokens in the db.

jess.support: Noting follow-up: run audit to see how many tenants used semicolon in CSV imports last 90d. Could be a handful.

alex.cs: Closing loop: customer will rotate and confirm. Marking as resolved on CS side pending eng PR. Thanks everyone.

leah.support: Marking CS ticket as waiting-on-engineering.

mike.eng: PR up: https://git.internal/r/redwood/provisioner/pulls/789 - will link post-review. :eyes:
